differential.name: Gestational hypertension
differential.rationale: New‑onset hypertension after 20 weeks gestation without proteinuria, a close mimic of pre‑eclampsia.

differential.name: Urinary tract infection (pyelonephritis)
differential.rationale: Pregnancy predisposes to UTIs; flank pain or fever could be confused with other complaints.

differential.name: Anemia of pregnancy
differential.rationale: Common in this age group and can cause fatigue and dyspnea, overlapping with other symptoms.
